claims.claim: Lilly broke ground September 21, 2026 on a $6.5B Houston manufacturing site intended to produce API for Foundayo (orforglipron) and other medicines, part of a stated $50B U.S. manufacturing expansion.

On September 29, 2026 Lilly reported an indirect treatment comparison in which Zepbound 15 mg was associated with 4.5% greater weight loss than Wegovy HD; the company explicitly identifies this as an indirect comparison rather than a new head-to-head randomized trial.

risks.risk: Large manufacturing commitments create execution/capital intensity risk if demand, approvals, pricing or competitive conditions change.
Indirect cross-trial comparisons are weaker evidence than direct randomized head-to-head trials and should not be treated as equivalent.

unknowns.unknown: Ramp timing, utilization and realized returns on the Houston site remain future execution questions.
